name: race_results_name_the_waves_on_the_road
description: A race decided while a team still has stacked waves on its road names them on the results (M8's review; design 2.7 and 5.8): racing the caretaker, I call waves 2 and 3 in wave 1, so waves 1 to 3 walk my road; my rival falls on wave 1 (a lives write), so clearing wave 1 wins; every creep of my wave 1 goes home and wave 1 clears with waves 2 and 3 still on my road. My crew's block says it was 'on waves 2–3 at' its race clock, where it named only the newest ('on wave 3').

steps.msg: the rival fell on wave 1: clearing it wins

steps.assert: sent > 0 and Game.outcome() == 'won' and Game.sim.waves_on_road(0) == PackedInt32Array([2, 3]) and Game.sim.race_time(0) < 0
steps.msg: wave 1 cleared and won the race, waves 2 and 3 still on my road
my crew's block names the waves on its road
